data.one_liner: YOLO object detection and instance segmentation for Flutter using LiteRT
data.what_it_does: Runs Ultralytics YOLO object detection and instance segmentation models on Android and iOS. Powered by LiteRT with CPU, GPU, and NPU acceleration.
use_when: You need real-time object detection or instance segmentation in a mobile app.
You want to run YOLO models (v5 to YOLO26) locally on device.
avoid_when: You need non-YOLO SSD models with uint8 inputs.
You are targeting Intel Macs for the iOS Simulator (arm64 only).
strengths: Supports multiple YOLO model versions and formats automatically.
Provides hardware acceleration via CPU, GPU, and NPU with fallback.
No OpenCV dependency, keeping native library size small.
weaknesses: iOS Simulator requires an Apple Silicon Mac.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum SDK 24 on Android and iOS 15+. Configure Swift Package Manager on iOS and declare camera permissions if capturing live frames.
